_doc: Reviewed dispensing corrections applied by generate_drug_pages.py over the PH FDA registry classification, keyed by registration number. Use only for a clearly miscoded registration; remove an entry once the FDA Philippines record is corrected or the OTC status is confirmed.

DRP-7116.reason: Losartan (an angiotensin II receptor blocker) is a prescription drug; this single registration (Natrazol 100 mg tablet) is coded OTC in the PH FDA registry, likely a coding error. Shown as Prescription (Rx) until OTC status is verified on the FDA Philippines record.
